title: androsaemum × pyramidale
intro: Androsaemum × pyramidale, commonly known as burnet, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the rose family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include promoting relaxation, reducing anxiety and stress, and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents present in burnet, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The health benefits of burnet include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and protecting against oxidative stress.
